note: Ground truth labelled by a Claude agent from the Muse Voice Transcribe narration and 1 fps frames, blind to the model's plan; not yet human-reviewed. Exact hole/row positions are not legible at 1 fps, so instructions name rails and parts, not hole numbers; the 9 V snap wire is said to go red-to-red rail, but only the narration confirms which hole.

steps.instruction: Push the 9 V snap connector's red wire into the red (+) rail and its black wire into the blue (-) rail.
steps.done_looks_like: The snap connector's red and black wire ends sit in the top-left power rails of the breadboard, with the clip lying off the left edge.
steps.evidence: Transcript 42.3 'taking the snap connector... red wire into the red rail'; hand picks up connector at 43, wires in the board by 51, adjusted until 56.

steps.instruction: Insert the blue LED with its short leg (cathode) toward the ground rail.
steps.done_looks_like: The blue LED stands upright near the top rail, short leg in the ground-rail side.
steps.evidence: Transcript ~60-90 'put the LED in... short leg... cathode towards the ground rail'; LED picked up at 59, pushed in 60-77, shown close up 78-81, settled view at 82.

steps.instruction: Insert the short red jumper wire in the row beside the LED's anode.
steps.done_looks_like: A short red jumper wire lies across the board just below the LED.
steps.evidence: Transcript ~85 'use this little short jumper wire'; hand reaches the jumper at 83, inserting 84-92, red jumper visible on the board at 93-94.

steps.instruction: Insert the 4.7 kΩ resistor from the positive rail to the jumper wire's row.
steps.done_looks_like: The resistor stands upright beside the LED, one lead in the positive rail and one in the jumper's row.
steps.evidence: Transcript 95.1 'put the resistor in... 4.7 kilo ohm... to the positive rail and then to our jumper'; picked up 97, leads bent 104-112, inserted 113-128, finished view 129.

steps.instruction: Snap the 9 V battery onto the snap connector so the LED lights.
steps.done_looks_like: The battery is clipped to the connector and the blue LED is lit.
steps.evidence: Transcript 135.1 'plug the battery in', 146.3 'there we go'; hand takes the clip at 136 and the battery at 138, snapped 140-145, LED glows from 143 and is clearly lit at 146.
